# graylog_event_definition (Data Source)

Retrieves a Graylog event definition by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "graylog_event_definition" "example" {
  id = "event-definition-id"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `alert` (Boolean)
- `config` (Dynamic)
- `description` (String)
- `field_spec` (Dynamic)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `key_spec` (List of String)
- `notification_settings` (Attributes) Notification timing settings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--notification_settings))
- `notifications` (Dynamic)
- `priority` (Number)
- `state` (String)
- `storage` (Dynamic)
- `title` (String)
